$comment: Traceability: reply to worker.artifacts.deliver. accepted:true means the service hashed, promoted, and committed the blob/version metadata; only then may the worker append run.completed. accepted:false carries a machine-readable rejection code; the worker surfaces a user-safe error and fails the turn (the PoC snapshot-failure path).

rejection.description: Present if and only if accepted is false.

stored_files.description: Present if and only if accepted is true: the promoted blobs.

title: service.artifacts.stored
